title: Actual generic lisse restriction, geometric sections and field automorphisms
statement: Let $X$ be an integral scheme [def-pc-integral-scheme], with function field $k=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$. Let $A$ be a normed field and $L\in\mathrm{Lisse}_A(X)$ with the all-continuous coefficient ring $R_{A,X}=p_X^*C(-,A)$ [def-sfb-norm-continuous-monodromy-data]. Let $\Omega/k$ be a separable closure [def-pd-separable-closure], with $X$, $A$, and $\Omega$ in a common universe $u$. Define $j:\operatorname{Spec}k\to X$ to be the canonical morphism from the stalk at the generic point. Define the generic module $L_\eta=j^*L$ using the ordinary internal module pullback [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback]. Let $U_\Omega$ be the separable-closure object of $(\operatorname{Spec}k)_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-sfb-field-separable-cech-nerve]. Define its additive group of geometric sections by $V_A(L)=(L_\eta)(U_\Omega)$, equivalently the global sections of the restriction to the slice over $U_\Omega$. For every $g\in\operatorname{Aut}_k(\Omega)$ define the site endomorphism $a_g:U_\Omega\to U_\Omega$ with underlying morphism $\operatorname{Spec}(g)$; its over-$k$ equation is $\operatorname{Spec}(k\to\Omega)\circ\operatorname{Spec}(g)=\operatorname{Spec}(k\to\Omega)$. The associated map on $V_A(L)$ is restriction along $a_g$. These are the actual pullback and evaluated section objects, without a chosen basis, representation, or assertion of full faithfulness.

source.place: Bhatt–Scholze, Lemma 7.4.7 and Lemma 7.4.10, pp. 70–71; actual generic restriction and separable-closure section objects in lem-sfb-generic-lisse-scalar-comparison, proof steps 3 and 5. The canonical Spec(g) endomorphism is the field descent construction of Example 4.1.10.
